step1_figure.circuit_type: NMOS Differential Pair with Cascode Current Sink
step1_figure.description: Figure 22.2 shows an NMOS differential amplifier (M1, M2) with drains tied to VDD and sources coupled to an NMOS cascode current sink biased by Vbias3 and Vbias4 from the wide-swing bias generator (SUB_1 / Fig. 20.43).

tail_current.description: Total DC tail current (Iss) sunk by the NMOS cascode current sink

equation.explanation: The cascode current sink biased by Vbias3 and Vbias4 sets the total differential pair tail current Iss.
equation.assumptions: M6t and M6b are operating in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With nominal bias mirroring designed for ~40 uA from the wide-swing bias stage, Iss is nominally 40 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard biasing provides 40 uA nominal tail current, with variations due to process and temperature.

quiescent_branch_current.description: Quiescent drain current in each input transistor under balanced input condition (VI1 = VI2)

equation.explanation: When gate inputs are balanced (VI1 = VI2 = VCM), the tail current splits equally between M1 and M2.
equation.assumptions: M1 and M2 are matched and in saturation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Equal division of the 40 uA tail current.

vi1_max_steering.description: Maximum gate voltage on M1 where all tail current is steered to M1 (ID1 = Iss, ID2 = 0)

equation.formula: vI1_MAX = sqrt((2 * L * Iss) / (KP_n * W)) + vI2 = sqrt(2) * Vov + vI2
equation.explanation: The maximum input voltage on M1 that completely shuts off M2, steering all current into M1.
equation.assumptions: Square-law saturation model for M1/M2; M2 turns off when VGS2 = VTHN.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Input voltage is ~170 mV above VI2 (0.9 V) to steer 100% current.

vi1_min_steering.description: Minimum gate voltage on M1 where all tail current is steered to M2 (ID1 = 0, ID2 = Iss)

equation.formula: vI1_MIN = vI2 - sqrt((2 * L * Iss) / (KP_n * W)) = vI2 - sqrt(2) * Vov
equation.explanation: The minimum input voltage on M1 at which M1 shuts off completely.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric with respect to vI1_MAX around VI2 = 0.9 V.

vcm_max.description: Maximum common-mode input voltage to keep M1 and M2 in saturation

equation.explanation: Since drains of M1 and M2 are tied to VDD, VDS >= VGS - VTHN implies VDD >= VG - VTHN, or VG <= VDD + VTHN.
equation.assumptions: VD = VDD (tied directly to supply rail).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Gate can exceed VDD by one threshold voltage before M1 and M2 enter the triode region.

vcm_min.description: Minimum common-mode input voltage to keep the tail current source and input pair in saturation

equation.explanation: Gate voltage must support the VGS of the input pair plus the minimum compliance voltage across the cascode current sink (2 * VDS,sat).
equation.assumptions: Cascode sink transistors require at least 2 * VDS,sat across them.

sky130_expected.calculation: VGS1,2 = VTHN + Vov = 0.42 + 0.122 = 0.542 V. Assuming 2 * VDS,sat approx 0.25 V: VCM_MIN = 0.542 + 0.25 = 0.792 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Below ~0.8 V the cascode current source enters triode, causing tail current Iss to collapse.

transconductance_gm.description: Small-signal transconductance of each input transistor (M1, M2)

equation.formula: gm = 2 * ID / (VGS - VTHN) = sqrt(2 * KP_n * (W/L) * ID)
equation.explanation: Determines the small-signal AC current response to differential input voltage vdi: id = gm * (vdi / 2).
equation.assumptions: Transistors in saturation with ID = Iss / 2.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Evaluated at ID = 20 uA, W/L = 10, un*Cox = 270 uA/V^2.

diff_ac_current_amplitude.description: AC component of drain current id for a 1 mV peak differential input

equation.explanation: For an AC input vI1 = VCM + v_ac, vgs1 = -vgs2 = v_ac / 2. The AC current amplitude is id = gm * (v_ac / 2).

sky130_expected.calculation: For v_ac = 1 mV: id = (328 uA/V) * (0.5 mV) = 164 nA peak.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Follows directly from gm * 0.5 mV for 1 mV peak AC input.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench measuring Iss, quiescent ID1/ID2, differential steering limits (vI1_min, vI1_max), transconductance gm, and AC current amplitude for Figure 22.2.
